primary_estimand: Externally verified FAIL discrimination by max_negative_balance within the first 8 absolute PRAMA windows (nominally 128 generated tokens), independent of generation-cap truncation.

independent_unit.interpretation: problem_id is the independent sampling and inferential unit; the two condition sessions are correlated repeated observations within problem.

cluster_inference.statistic: AUROC of max_negative_balance at absolute window horizon 8 with FAIL=1
cluster_inference.exchangeability: Reassign complete ordered (clean_control, negation_objective) outcome vectors among complete at-risk problem_id clusters; never permute sessions independently.

monte_carlo.exact_fallback: Enumerate unique cluster outcome-profile assignments when their multinomial count is at most exact_fallback_max_assignments.

incremental_auc_test.minimum_effect_interpretation: A gain smaller than 0.05 AUROC is not scientifically material even if statistically significant.
incremental_auc_test.decision_rule: Require observed difference >= 0.05, centered one-sided cluster-bootstrap p < 0.01, and the one-sided 99% percentile lower confidence bound > 0.

sampling_plan.id_hash_basis: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON array of sorted deterministic session IDs

model_version.identity_limitation: The hosted endpoint exposes neither an immutable weight digest nor a non-null system fingerprint; provider-side revision under the alias cannot be excluded.

generation_budget_binding.selection_basis: Provider-supported high ceiling fixed externally before holdout acquisition; no additional generation-budget calibration.

sampling_plan.stopping_rule: Acquire and verify exactly the 240 frozen holdout sessions; do not reacquire the 20 calibration sessions already used to freeze the projector. No outcome-dependent early stopping, replacement or enrichment.

analysis_order: Verify frozen dataset, projector calibration, interface and design hashes
Acquire every frozen holdout session without interface or PRAMA metadata in the model payload
Run finish_reason by outcome and perturbation audits before score interpretation
Construct the complete-cluster at-risk set at absolute window horizon 8
Check frozen session and problem-cluster class quotas within that risk set
Run the cluster-aware primary permutation test at horizon 8
Run the paired cluster-bootstrap test of AUROC_PRAMA - AUROC_delta at horizon 8
Report mandatory delta vs xi vs balance comparison
Report other absolute horizons as mandatory secondary and relative prefixes as exploratory
holdout_validity_rule: The untouched test partition must contain all 120 frozen problem_id clusters with both conditions at risk through window 8, at least 20 FAIL sessions, at least 20 PASS sessions, at least 20 problem clusters containing a FAIL, and at least 20 containing a PASS. Otherwise the result is inconclusive_insufficient_class_support.
confirmatory_rule: After passing the generation-cap audit, require at horizon 8: cluster-aware max_negative_balance association p < 0.01; observed AUROC_PRAMA - AUROC_delta >= 0.05; paired problem-cluster bootstrap p < 0.01 and one-sided 99% lower bound > 0; and max_negative_balance AUROC strictly greater than every frozen instantaneous/logprob baseline.
kernel_change_policy: Do not modify theta, tau, accumulated-excess, capacity, normalization or any PRAMA kernel parameter until the activation audit establishes whether accumulated_excess or capacity were reached under the frozen kernel.
hosted_model_identity_caveat: The design is confirmatory for the named NVIDIA hosted deployment and frozen request surface, but cannot claim immutable-weight reproducibility because the provider exposes no digest or non-null system fingerprint.
